description: Bus Lanes is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. This dataset is linked to the following visualization: Visualization - Bus Lanes This dataset contains details of the locations of Bus Lanes throughout Leicester City. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are bus. The portal shows 70 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
